title: Requester→specialist handoff record (consultation-request)
description: Single JSONL record appended to .scratch/handoff.jsonl when a specialist (typically feature-implementer in the inner TDD loop) needs a focused answer from another specialist (typically system-design-expert) without advancing the pipeline. The router (handoff.py route) dispatches the target agent in consultation mode and returns control to the requester after the matching consultation-response is appended. Consultations preserve the requester's active state; they do not advance the pipeline stage.

type.description: Discriminator. Always "consultation-request" for this record type.

req_id.description: Requirement ID this consultation relates to.

ts.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the record was appended.

author.description: The specialist asking. The router returns control here after the matching consultation-response is appended.

target.description: The specialist being asked. The router dispatches this agent in consultation mode.

context.description: Brief prose context — where in the work this question arose (for example, "red→green transition for behavior X in slice Y").

question.description: The focused question being asked. Stays narrow — broad open-ended questions belong in a triage, not a consultation.

stop_state.description: Optional. Where the requester paused (for example, "file:line, awaiting answer before writing the next test"). Helps the requester resume cleanly after the consultation-response arrives.
